issues.failure_explanation: The Gaussian dynamics are linear with drift matrix A_t = -(γ/κ)(I - (β/κ)P_t C_{*,t}^{-1}), where P_t multiplies from the left as seen in the weighted-mean formula. The covariance therefore obeys the Lyapunov equation Σ̇_t = A_tΣ_t + Σ_tA_t^T + 2C_{*,t} with A_t^T = -(γ/κ)(I - (β/κ)C_{*,t}^{-1}P_t). The stated ODE instead contains Σ_tP_tC_{*,t}^{-1} where the correct term is Σ_tC_{*,t}^{-1}P_t, and the proof's intermediate step likewise writes Σ_t(I - (β/κ)P_tC_{*,t}^{-1}) for Σ_tA_t^T, dropping the transpose order. Since P_t and C_{*,t}^{-1} do not commute in general — e.g., for the default preconditioner C_{*,t} = Σ_t whenever Σ and Σ_t do not commute — the displayed covariance ODE is false for generic Gaussian targets and transient states.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the last summand Σ_tP_tC_{*,t}^{-1} by Σ_tC_{*,t}^{-1}P_t in the lemma's covariance ODE and write the proof's second term as Σ_tA_t^T = -(γ/κ)Σ_t(I - (β/κ)C_{*,t}^{-1}P_t). The lemma then holds as stated by the standard Lyapunov equation, and no downstream result changes.
issues.overall_effect: The transient covariance evolution stated in Lemma 2 is incorrect for non-commuting (Σ, Σ_t, C_{*,t}), including the paper's default preconditioner C(ρ_t) away from stationarity; the mean ODE is correct. No labelled downstream result is invalidated: Corollary 1 evaluates the ODE only at Σ_t = Σ, where all matrices commute and the two orderings coincide, and Lemma 5 uses a parameter choice where P_tC_{*,t}^{-1} is a scalar matrix, so both orderings agree there as well.
issues.title: Covariance ODE in Gaussian moment lemma has transposed factor order
issues.why_classification: The repair is a single forced factor swap inside one display that makes the lemma true with the same proof; every corollary and comparison result is already correct, so no substantive claim, guarantee, or advertised scope is lost.
